text: しんぴん　じてんしゃで　かのじょと　サイクリングさ！

structure.jp: しんぴん　じてんしゃで

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says by what means the action is done. じてんしゃで = 'by Bicycle'.

patterns.name: 〜さ
patterns.explanation: さ at the end takes the place of だ and sounds breezy and self-assured, mostly in men's talk. サイクリングさ = 'it's cycling, you know'.
